topic: Frequency calculation for new Brazilian markets
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting frequency calculations, specifically for two new cities in Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo). [p1] noted that the current system does not apply the new frequency model to these locations. The existing SQL function (`getFrequency_3C`) was reviewed, showing complex logic based on city and company number. It was determined that separating calculations by city is difficult because a single sample selection might include locations from multiple cities, requiring either a universal formula for the company or an averaging attempt.

[me] advised against immediately implementing the new formula for Brazil, noting that partial migration to `ml-api` would introduce many nuances. The current frequency calculation logic was provided via SQL.
decisions: The immediate implementation of the new frequency model for all Brazilian locations is postponed.
Future work on frequency modeling should consider a universal formula or averaging approach rather than city-specific separation.
action_items: [p1] will review the complexity of multi-city frequency calculation and follow up.
